name: TACO: Trash Annotations in Context for Litter Detection
description: TACO is an open-source image dataset designed to advance automated litter detection and waste management technologies. Developed by researchers at the University of Surrey, it contains high-resolution photographs taken in diverse real-world indoor and outdoor environments with bounding boxes and polygonal segmentation masks classifying litter into a hierarchical taxonomy of 60 waste classes.
